def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    occ=[r[:] for r in g]
    floor=comps(g,2)
    assert len(floor)==1
    fmax=max(r for r,_ in floor[0])
    dr=-1 if fmax==H-1 else 1   # slide toward anchor edge
    colors=set(x for r in g for x in r)-{2}
    objs=[comps(g,c)[0] for c in colors]
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for comp in objs:
            c=g[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]
            nxt={(r+dr,b) for r,b in comp}
            if all(0<=rr<H for rr,_ in nxt) and all(occ[rr][bb]==0 for rr,bb in nxt):
                for r,b in comp: occ[r][b]=0
                for r,b in comp: occ[r+dr][b]=c
                changed=True
    return occ
